task:
FIX FIVE REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #819 (purge P2b1), review round 1. Branch codex/run-38735057403-1 at b8448717241f439d3bfd856be98d1335a0796c60. Keep everything else unchanged; do not weaken tests.

R1 (P1, real failure, also breaks the CI lane 'Finder derived-data tests (PostgreSQL 18)' with UndefinedTable): scripts/operator/lib/v3_generation_purge.py EXTRA_COUNTS_SQL (and any EXCLUSIONS SQL in the helpers) reference v3_derived.system_archetype_summary, which does not exist. The view is v3_app.system_archetype_summary (migration 011 line ~300, replaced in 015 line ~361). Query the real view (check the executor role can read it; if it cannot under 016's grants, drop the view count and keep the direct v3_derived.system_archetype target-row check, and say which you did). Keep the direct target-row check against v3_derived.system_archetype.

R2 (status must not skip a mandatory gate): after `authorize`, `next_mode` recommends delete-system-search, skipping `verify-system-archetype-empty`. Make the verification durable and observable: record its successful result in a way `status` can read (prefer an existing 016 ledger mechanism -- e.g. a purge event 016 already admits -- and do NOT change migration 016; if no 016 mechanism fits, require the sealed verification receipt, by path + SHA-256, as an input to the destructive modes P2b2 will add, and make status report the gate as 'not proven' until it is). `status` must recommend verify-system-archetype-empty until that proof exists.

R3 (status must work during a live rewrite): `status` runs PLAN_SQL exact count(*) scans of every payload table before its own branch; during a live VACUUM FULL those need ACCESS SHARE and hit the 5 s lock_timeout, so status aborts in exactly the recovery case it exists for. Make `status` report unresolved ledger state, backend identity and the admissible recovery mode FIRST, and skip (report as null with a reason) any count/size probe for a relation that is locked by an open REWRITE_STARTED backend or that times out on its lock.

R4 (bounds): actor and reason are length-checked after strip() but the raw values are stored in the sealed plan and in 016's reviewed_plan. Reject when the RAW value exceeds the bounds or is not already stripped (do not silently rewrite input).

R5 (CodeQL 'Incomplete URL substring sanitization' alert, fails the required CodeQL check): tests/test_v3_derived_generation_purge_operator.py line ~235 does `'nb79a3d.mevnode.com' in source`. Replace substring assertions on the host with an exact check of the module constants (e.g. purge_operator.FQDN == 'nb79a3d.mevnode.com' and purge_operator.HOST == 'ed-finder-prod'), and check no other new line triggers the same rule.

Add/adjust tests for R1-R4 (PG18 tests may skip on the runner: report written-not-run). Run: ruff check .; bash -n scripts/operator/actions/v3-derived-generation-purge.sh; python -m pytest -q tests/test_v3_derived_generation_purge_operator.py tests/test_v3_purge_transactions.py tests/test_v3_governed_derived_purge.py tests/test_f2d_operator_identity.py tests/test_v3_derived_generation_purge_mutators.py tests/test_v3_purge_deployment_fences.py; python scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py --operation authority-gate; the Semgrep command from .github/workflows/semgrep.yml. Allowed files: those already changed by this PR. End with files changed, what you did per R1-R5, tests run with counts.
